name: Wakou Ouka
source:
A little girl Kanata found at the shrine in the village, who was waiting for her parents. She always plays with her cat called Shamon.

(from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snow_(visual_novel)]Wikipedia[/url])
